files.text:
metadata:
  title: "Calculator Registry"
  version: "2.0"
  last_updated: "2026-10-31"
  description: "The calculator and its neighbour"

scenarios:
  calc-001-double:
    description: Doubling a number returns twice its value
    service: calc
    path: tests/calc/calc_test.go
    merged_steps:
      given: [the calculator is installed]
      when: [the Owner doubles 3]
      then: [the result is 6]
  neighbour-001-greets:
    description: The neighbour greets the Owner who knocks
    service: neighbour
    path: tests/neighbour/neighbour_test.go
    merged_steps:
      given: [the neighbour is at home]
      when: [the Owner knocks]
      then: [the greeting is "hello"]
  calc-halve-001-even:
    description: Halving an even number returns half its value
    service: calc
    path: tests/calc/calc_test.go
    last_updated: "2026-10-31"
    user_stories:
      - story: docs/product/stories/calc-halve-a-number.yaml
        scenario_id: calc-halve-001-even
        merge_date: "2026-10-31"
    merged_steps:
      given: [the calculator is installed]
      when: [the Owner halves 6]
      then: [the result is 3]
